name: adminigloo-e2e
description: Real-browser (Playwright) tests for browser-behaviour code. DELIBERATELY OUTSIDE the pnpm workspace (see the note in packages/testing/src/playwright.ts): a normal `pnpm install` at the repo root must never pull a browser driver into every library's typecheck. Install and run this only when you want browser tests — `cd e2e && pnpm install && pnpm browsers && pnpm test`.
